question: Are humans and machine learning systems fooled by the same kinds of illusions?
title: A Surprising Density of Illusionable Natural Speech
answer_rationale: The documents suggest that humans and machine learning systems can both be fooled by illusions, with evidence that humans can be deceived by subtle perturbations (e.g., McGurk effect, Yanny/Laurel illusion) similar to adversarial examples that fool ML systems. Text 5 explicitly asks if humans are fooled like ML systems, and Text 6 and Text 10 note similarities between human illusions and adversarial examples, while Text 2 and Text 3 highlight that human perception may be vulnerable to security risks akin to those affecting ML systems.
